claims.statement: Microsoft Sentinel documents incidents as containers of investigation evidence and automation rules as triggers, conditions and actions that may update incidents or invoke playbooks.
claims.locator: Components; Incident-based or alert-based automation
claims.limitations: Does not support the synthetic risk score, grouping, source authority or database implementation.

claims.statement: Microsoft Sentinel playbooks use Azure Logic Apps. Its documented prerequisites distinguish incident access, manual playbook operation and automation execution roles, with separate service-account resource-group permissions.

claims.limitations: No role assignment or live run performed. Synthetic approval hash, five-minute TTL and duty split are not product facts.

claims.statement: For the documented Okta-driven deprovision path, the downstream SCIM user is updated active=false; deleting an already deactivated Okta user does not send a downstream resource DELETE.
claims.locator: How does SCIM work? / Delete (Deprovision)
claims.limitations: Limited to described direction and setup; does not prove arbitrary downstream access/session revocation or erasure.

claims.statement: Okta Classic Engine guide distinguishes access/refresh token revocation and session cookies; revoking access does not revoke associated refresh, revoking refresh also revokes associated access, and invalid/expired/already revoked token requests can return 200.
claims.locator: Classic Engine note; About the revoke request; Revoke an access token or a refresh token; Remove a user session
claims.limitations: Not a current endpoint-schema verification or claim about all engines, application-local sessions or offline token checking.

claims.statement: H08 uses separate evidence, incident, immutable plan, time-bound authorization, run and per-effect step objects; risk ranking never grants execution authority.
claims.locator: H08.md: 一条信号怎样成为一个事件 / 从事件工作台到外部效果; H08.json lifecycles
claims.limitations: Original teaching design; five-minute authorization, approval duties and technology options have not been production-validated.

claims.statement: R1 deduplicates scoped source event IDs, anchors ten-minute windows by first event per scoped principal and computes a capped severity/diversity/asset score; toy results are W1=100 and W2=70.
claims.locator: H08.md: 手算关联与风险排序
claims.limitations: Not a probability, detector efficacy result or provider algorithm; late data changes group versions. Shared IP is not principal identity.

claims.statement: A timeout cannot establish whether a side effect happened. Repeating a time-varying all-sessions action may affect sessions created after the first request, so local retry identity cannot alone guarantee unchanged business effect.
claims.locator: H08.md: 正常执行、未知结果与误封恢复; guide Remove a user session provides scoped action context only
claims.limitations: General distributed-state and changing-set reasoning, not a documented promise that a specific Okta endpoint retries this way. Exact endpoint behavior remains unverified.

claims.statement: False-positive recovery must reconcile in-flight effects and current rights, obtain new authority, and preserve prior actions; restored access does not resurrect revoked credentials.
claims.locator: H08.md: 正常执行、未知结果与误封恢复; H08.json RecoveryPlan lifecycle
claims.limitations: Original safety invariant for the synthetic service; current provider constraints must be verified. No actual recovery or token operation executed.

claims.statement: A 100-item synthetic triage fixture separates escalation, routine handling and abstention: 16/24 escalation precision, 16/20 direct recall, 19/20 routed-human coverage and 32 items for human review.
claims.locator: H08.md: AI 辅助分诊的测量边界
claims.limitations: Constructed arithmetic only; no model was run. Cost assumptions and perfect human detection of abstained positives are hypothetical, not measured.
